FIELDS.NAME: Fairway Sports & Golf Equipment
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Store Manager, Fairway Sports & Golf Equipment, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@fairwaysports.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Fairway Sports & Golf Equipment operates as a retail store specializing in golf and sporting goods. Our core operations involve the sale of high-quality equipment and apparel for athletes and leisure sports enthusiasts alike. We focus on providing exceptional customer service, promoting an organized and clean shopping environment to ensure safety for both customers and staff. Our inventory primarily consists of items essential for golf, tennis, fitness, and other recreational sports. We maintain robust safety protocols and comply with all local regulations to foster a safe shopping experience. To minimize risk, we do not engage in rental operations or repair services, ensuring our liability exposure remains low. Additionally, we have implemented a professionally monitored alarm system to safeguard our premises. With a strong emphasis on financial stability and responsible inventory management, we continually adapt our offerings to meet seasonal demands and customer preferences. Furthermore, our relationship with reputable suppliers helps us guarantee quality products for our clientele.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Fairway Sports & Golf Equipment does not own or operate any other businesses.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 09/15/2023; Cause: Theft of inventory during a break-in; Amount: $1,250.00; Status: Closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Listed Fireproof Safe, Class 350, One Hour Fire Rating
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Professionally monitored alarm system with 24/7 surveillance.
